capture_method: User report plus source-contract inspection; this checkout intentionally has no StateServer bridge.

reported_failures.behavior: The compact-card add and share controls no longer respond to taps and their glyphs are absent.
reported_failures.source_evidence: The custom ButtonStyle replaces configuration.label with a hit-testing-disabled duplicate image, so the native button label is no longer the visible interaction carrier.
reported_failures.expected: The native button label remains centered above the expanding glass, receives taps, and preserves native drag-away cancellation.

reported_failures.behavior: The Nearby permission badge appears on the upper-left edge.
reported_failures.source_evidence: RecenterButton attaches its badge with a topLeading overlay alignment.
reported_failures.expected: The active red badge appears on the upper-right edge.

reported_failures.behavior: Place-card action glyphs are not visible.
reported_failures.source_evidence: PlaceCardGlassActionButtonStyle composites the caller label inside an expanding glass background without an explicit foreground glyph layer.
reported_failures.expected: Every compact-card add and share button renders a centered white SF Symbol at rest and throughout the press animation.

reported_failures.behavior: Tapping the already-selected map pin minimizes or replaces its compact card.
reported_failures.source_evidence: Both active and inactive annotations call the same selection replacement functions.
reported_failures.expected: An active pin tap preserves the selection and compact card and replays only the pin bounce.

reported_failures.behavior: A coordinate-only dropped pin produces a malformed compact card.
reported_failures.source_evidence: PlaceProfilePreviewCard.cardPhoto returns no view when a dropped pin has no image, while the entire card surface is built from cardPhoto.
reported_failures.expected: A dropped pin always has a full 232-point compact surface titled Dropped Pin with distance, add, and share actions.

reported_failures.behavior: Nearby begins moving away while the compact card is still sliding.
reported_failures.source_evidence: presentCompactCard animates nearbyLift in the same transaction as the card entrance.
reported_failures.expected: Nearby remains fully present and stationary until the card entrance completes, and returns only after dismissal completes.

product_contract.dropped_pin_name_scope: Per user-place save; never mutates the canonical coordinate place.
product_contract.shared_visibility: The label may be shown with that user's memory only when the viewer is authorized to see it.
